def _sign_hmac(hash_algorithm_name: str, sig_base_str: str, client_secret:
    str, resource_owner_secret: str):
    # Create the key from client_secret and resource_owner_secret
    key = '{}&{}'.format(
        utils.escape(client_secret or ''),
        utils.escape(resource_owner_secret or '')
    )

    # Convert key and message to bytes
    key_bytes = key.encode('ascii')
    message_bytes = sig_base_str.encode('ascii')

    # Map hash algorithm name to hashlib algorithm
    hash_alg_map = {
        'SHA-1': hashlib.sha1,
        'SHA-256': hashlib.sha256,
        'SHA-512': hashlib.sha512,
    }
    hash_alg = hash_alg_map[hash_algorithm_name]

    # Calculate HMAC
    hashed = hmac.new(key_bytes, message_bytes, hash_alg)

    # Return base64-encoded signature
    return binascii.b2a_base64(hashed.digest())[:-1].decode('ascii')
